author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Four members of a family aboard a small plane that disappeared off the Bahamas were found dead Tuesday, a relative told The Associated Press.

Silvia Larrieu said relatives searching by boat recovered the bodies and were working with the U.S. Coast Guard to bring them home. The victims were Mario Lamar, 80; his wife, Lili Lamar, 79; and their grandchildren, Sofi Sosa, 28, and Christian Sosa, 22.

The PA-34 Piper left Great Harbour Cay in the Berry Islands on Monday morning for Miami Executive Airport. Bahamas police said air traffic control lost contact when the aircraft was about 13 miles west of Andros Island. Family members alerted authorities after messages went undelivered and the expected arrival time passed.

The Coast Guard sent an aircraft to assist after Bahamian authorities requested help, although poor weather delayed parts of the search. The developing work now centers on recovery and the investigation into what caused the plane to go down. Authorities had not announced a cause in the information available Tuesday night.
dek: Relatives located the victims after launching a search for the small plane, which lost contact while flying toward Miami.
headline: Relative says four family members found dead after Bahamas plane disappeared
